verdict.rationale: Helicone's Sessions feature groups related requests so you can trace an entire agent flow in one unified view, and path syntax expresses parent-child relationships, which gives nested, hierarchical traces of multi-step runs. The GitHub README also lists sessions and traces as first-class UI concepts. missing for 10: documented instrumentation of non-LLM steps (tool calls, custom spans) as nested spans, independent hands-on corroboration of the sessions/nested-trace view.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace multi-step agent runs as nested spans grouped into sessions or threads

citations.quote: Sessions group these related requests together, letting you trace the entire agent flow from initial user input to final response in one unified view.
Use path syntax to represent parent-child relationships
Rapidly test and iterate on prompts, sessions and traces in our UI.
